text: FAA guidance says discontinue flight and/or avoid further flights when control inputs are not synchronized or delayed, and to conduct a control link check before operations over people. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual lists signal loss options (Return to Home, Hover, Land) and signal loss actions (Continue mission, Auto RTH), and notes that if the link is restored within 10 seconds, control returns to the remote controller; during automated missions the drone will continue until disconnection and then execute the preset action. Incident reports: no usable evidence available. Main gap/conflict: FAA guidance emphasizes discontinuation, while Autel’s options allow continuing or Auto RTH, plus automated-flight behavior may persist until disconnection, creating an open question about appropriate signal-loss settings in practice.
